title: Apprentices and trainees – concessions and assistance
summary: Find information and assistance regarding concessions and financial support for apprentices and trainees in NSW.
who_can_apply: NSW apprentices (including those whose training starts before 30 June 2025)
First or second year apprentices registered with the NSW Department of Education (for vehicle rebate)
Apprentices or trainees who have lost their job (for CAPS registration)
Individuals training in a priority occupation
what_you_need: For fee-free apprenticeships: None specified (all NSW apprentices are eligible).
For vehicle rebate: Registration with the NSW Department of Education.
For financial support in priority occupations: Training in a priority occupation.
For CAPS assistance: Being an apprentice or trainee who has lost their job.
For employer support: Visiting the Australian Apprenticeships website.

internal_links.text: Apply for an apprentice vehicle registration rebate
Apply for the VTAS travel and accommodation allowance
Register with Continuing Apprentices and Trainees Placement Service (CAPS)
Apply for CAPS relocation and rental assistance

faqs.q: Are there upfront fees for apprenticeships?
faqs.a: No, under the fee-free apprenticeship initiative, employees and apprentices pay no upfront fees.

faqs.q: How can I get financial support for my apprenticeship?
faqs.a: You may be eligible for incentives when training in a priority occupation to help offset the cost of living and complete your apprenticeship.

faqs.q: What should I do if I lose my job as an apprentice or trainee?
faqs.a: Register with Continuing Apprentices and Trainees Placement Service (CAPS) as soon as you can.

faqs.q: What support is available for employers?
faqs.a: Visit the Australian Apprenticeships website for information on employer programs, including the Priority Wage Subsidy and Group Training Organisation Reimbursement Program.
